usageNotes: Use this to inspect the installed and available versions of key Proxmox packages (e.g., pve-manager, proxmox-ve, qemu-server) on a specific node — useful before or after running apt upgrades to confirm version state. The node must be online and reachable by the API; the caller needs Sys.Audit on /nodes/{node}. This endpoint returns package state only for Proxmox-curated packages, not the full dpkg database.

examples.summary: List important package versions on node 'pve1'

tips: The 'Version' field is the candidate upgrade version from apt, while 'OldVersion' is what is currently installed — if they differ, an update is available for that package.
The 'RunningKernel' field is only populated for the 'proxmox-ve' meta-package entry; use it to confirm whether a kernel update requires a reboot to take effect.
The 'ManagerVersion' field reflects the live pve-manager API version and may differ from the installed package version if an upgrade happened without a service restart.
NotifyStatus shows the version for which an update notification was already sent — useful for suppressing duplicate alerts in automation.
